harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a routed path from node3 (behind VyOS node1 on lan-a) through transit to node4's HTTP service on TCP/8080 (behind OPNsense node2 on lan-b), with both routers keeping default-deny forward/filter policies for all other traffic. Discovered the actual physical wiring via arping (node1 eth1↔node2 vtnet1 = transit; node1 eth2↔node3 = lan-a; node2 vtnet2↔node4 = lan-b), addressed all links (transit 10.10.100.0/24, lan-a 10.10.10.0/24, lan-b 10.10.20.0/24), added static routes on node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) plus host routes on node3/node4, stood up a systemd HTTP service on node4:8080 (opened in firewalld), added a VyOS forward-filter default-drop + established/related + explicit tcp/8080-to-10.10.20.10 rule on node1, and an OPNsense pf pass rule on the transit (wan) interface scoped to lan-a source / node4:8080 destination only. Verified node3 can curl node4:8080 successfully while ping and other ports/hosts between the two networks remain refused. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for all four nodes (node1, node2, node3, node4), confirming changed boot identity (boot_id/kern.boottime) after each reboot and full recovery of interfaces, routes, firewall rules, and the HTTP service/data path before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Enumerated topology and confirmed wiring node1-eth1↔node2-vtnet1 (transit), node1-eth2↔node3 (lan-a), node2-vtnet2↔node4 (lan-b) via arping

Addressed transit (10.10.100.0/24), lan-a (10.10.10.0/24) and lan-b (10.10.20.0/24) links on node1 (VyOS set/commit/save), node2 (OPNsense config.xml + configctl interface reconfigure), node3 and node4 (nmcli static)

Added static routes: node1 to 10.10.20.0/24 via 10.10.100.2 (VyOS), node2 to 10.10.10.0/24 via 10.10.100.1 (OPNsense gateway object + staticroutes + rc.routing_configure), node3 to 10.10.20.0/24 via 10.10.10.254, node4 to 10.10.10.0/24 via 10.10.20.254
Deployed a systemd-managed python http.server on node4:8080 serving /srv/http8080/index.html, opened firewalld port 8080/tcp
Configured VyOS forward filter: default-action drop, rule 5 accept established/related, rule 10 accept tcp/8080 to 10.10.20.10 inbound on eth2 (lan-a)
Configured OPNsense filter: added pass rule on wan (transit) restricted to source 10.10.10.0/24 destination 10.10.20.10 port 8080/tcp via config.xml edit + configctl filter reload
Verified golden path (node3 curl node4:8080 succeeds) and refused paths (ping and other ports time out) both pre- and post-restart

Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 sequentially (one at a time), polling for command execution to resume and confirming changed boot_id (Linux nodes) or kern.boottime (OPNsense) each time, followed by re-verification of interfaces, routes, firewall rules, and the HTTP data path before moving to the next node

evidence.requirement: Baseline topology/wiring discovery (node1-node3 lan-a, node1-node2 transit, node2-node4 lan-b)
evidence.summary: Confirmed real L2 adjacency via arping MAC matches, establishing eth1(node1)-vtnet1(node2)=transit, eth2(node1)-enp8s0(node3)=lan-a, vtnet2(node2)-enp8s0(node4)=lan-b

evidence.requirement: Interface/route configuration on node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) and end hosts
evidence.summary: Verified addresses and routes present via show/ip route/netstat -rn on all four nodes after configuration

evidence.requirement: HTTP service on node4:8080 stood up and reachable
evidence.summary: systemd service demo-http8080 active and firewalld port 8080/tcp opened; curl localhost:8080 returned expected content

evidence.requirement: Firewall path opened only for node3->node4:8080, other traffic refused
evidence.summary: OPNsense pf rule and VyOS forward-filter rule confirmed in ruleset dumps; curl to node4:8080 from node3 succeeded (node4 http ok) while ping and port 22/80 to the far network timed out

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id changed 2674ee60->9f2dfa07; post-reboot interfaces/routes/firewall config and node3->node4:8080 path verified working

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: kern.boottime changed 06:08:34->06:19:09; post-reboot vtnet1/vtnet2 addresses, static route, and pf pass rule all present; HTTP path re-verified

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id changed 98aa35f5->9abf4c12; post-reboot routes intact and curl to node4:8080 succeeded

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id changed fbdf5b2c->da79786a; post-reboot demo-http8080 service active, firewalld port open, routes intact, and final end-to-end check from node3 confirmed HTTP works while ping remains refused
